specs.title: UI-ADM-TIL-009 actual administration UI with step evidence

annotations.description: Actual current React administration screens. Controlled browser login supplies UI-ADMIN-01 and TEST_OWNER, or the declared SUPER_USER. Controlled BFF routes return the case-declared records. Other controlled saves persist submitted field values. This run establishes frontend handling only. It does not execute BFF validation, storage, audit generation, or authorization.

steps.title: 1. Given Admin A is authenticated as fixture UI-ADMIN-01 with the case-specific permissions

2. And the Tile admin screen is open for UI-ADMIN-01; fixture record 101 is inactive and has Tile Name Fixture Tile; its owner is TEST_OWNER; Application Category Fixture Category is selected; the verify response returns record 101 with active true
3. When Admin A clicks icon button named "Verify" inside row with Record Id "101" in the "Tile" administration data grid
4. And Admin A clicks button named "Verified" inside the dialog named "verify ID: 101" inside the "Tile" administration tabpanel
5. Then cell named "Verified?" inside row with Record Id "101" in the "Tile" administration data grid contains the success icon with tooltip "Verified"
6. And icon button named "Verify" inside row with Record Id "101" in the "Tile" administration data grid is disabled
7. And icon button named "Deactivate" inside row with Record Id "101" in the "Tile" administration data grid is enabled
8. And dialog named "verify ID: 101" inside the "Tile" administration tabpanel is absent
